title: Drift-safe coverage without new ignore authority: receiver-owned watched canonical target
selector_layer: R1 selector (saimail.selector.select) over a decoded sailang.frame.TriageView
dependency_class: R1 attention coverage AFTER an R1 TriageView exists; NOT the Post Office header DEFER fallback, NOT transport/header scan opens, NOT the V2-02 fallback-open count, NOT the unknown wire-token fallback and NOT the opaque-claim fallback
v202_boundary: U1 numbers must never be compared directly to V2-02 fallback-open savings; V2-02 measured transport/header-policy suppression, U1 measures R1 attention escalation
watched_relation_definition: A watched relation is a canonical relation target appearing in the existing R1 relation_targets projection. The sender may assert the relation; the receiver alone declares whether the target is watched. Watching does not validate the sender assertion: it only raises receiver attention.
frame_projection_identity: sailang/frame.py FRAME_VERSION 4, BATCH_MARKER SAIB4, dictionary sailang/dictionary/v1.json
truth_authority: receiver need declared by the fixture row, independent of the selector verdict; a sender-asserted relation is an attention hint, never relevance truth
paired_input_requirement: baseline and treatment must receive byte-identical records and frames; the only changed receiver input is the watched set
post_result_adjustment: FORBIDDEN: no threshold, fixture, truth, watched-target, interest-field, acceptance-criteria or terminal-outcome change after observing the result
output_directory_rule: the evidence output directory must be new and empty; existing evidence is never overwritten

r1_stress_control.scope: the unchanged current R1 stress corpus (bench/selector_corpus.py), measured separately by the existing selector
